patch_description:
This crossover combines the current program’s robust endpoint linear initialization, persistent innovation handling, and displacement-based reversal gate with the inspiration program’s scalar constant-velocity covariance propagation and efficient moving-average implementation.

The enhanced filter uses a causal level-and-slope Kalman estimator with clipped innovations, bounded acceleration noise, and adaptive robust noise-scale learning. Output hysteresis remains separate from the internal state so genuine trends are tracked immediately while weak counter-trend motion must accumulate enough persistent evidence before creating an exposed reversal. The basic moving average is also changed to a cumulative-sum implementation for lower latency and O(n) execution.
